'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Mike D'Ambroise LS Communing''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mike D'Ambroise]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Handwritten. L6 sheet Tactical Obj: Hoth (V) → Tactical Reinforcements (V) pending QA. L17 Mess/BP → Sorry About The Mess & Blaster Proficiency. See notes/batch8_notes.py.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Communing]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
